description: Renders a responsive Sankey flow diagram as pure inline SVG without JavaScript dependencies.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Gets or sets additional CSS classes applied to the chart container.

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: Gets or sets the nodes and directed value flows to render.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: Gets or sets the CSS height of the chart container.

parameters.name: HighlightOnHover
parameters.description: Gets or sets whether hovering highlights connected nodes and links.

parameters.name: LinkOpacity
parameters.description: Gets or sets the base link opacity. Values outside zero to one are clamped.

parameters.name: MinLinkWidth
parameters.description: Gets or sets the minimum rendered link width in SVG view-box units.

parameters.name: NodePadding
parameters.description: Gets or sets the vertical gap between nodes in the same layer.

parameters.name: NodeWidth
parameters.description: Gets or sets the node width in SVG view-box units.

parameters.name: OnLinkClick
parameters.description: Raised when a Sankey link is clicked.

parameters.name: OnNodeClick
parameters.description: Raised when a Sankey node is clicked.

parameters.name: ShowLabels
parameters.description: Gets or sets whether node labels are rendered.

parameters.name: ShowValues
parameters.description: Gets or sets whether node values are appended to labels.

parameters.name: ValueFormatter
parameters.description: Gets or sets an optional value formatter. The default uses the current culture and the 0.## numeric format.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Gets or sets the CSS width of the chart container.
